find:
if (state.menu === 'none') return 'a state with no menu: nothing here is a hit target';
  return null;
why: Sweeps the three states that have no menu for menu hit targets. There is nothing to press in any of them -- the holding card has no application in it, the launch splash takes any key rather than offering a target, and a live board offers only the driving controls the collector excludes by design -- and the sweep reports "no controls measured" as a FAILURE, correctly, because for every other state that means the surface never opened. MEASURED: `screen.practice` was swept on the first attempt and failed in all four viewports, which is why the rule is keyed on a declared `menu` rather than on the two ids that were obvious before CI said otherwise.
killedBy: hit-sweep.mjs: which surfaces the visual gate sweeps excludes exactly the developer, startup-failure, no-script, match-failure and played-ending states, each for its rule
